principles: Direct statistical evidence receives the highest confidence.
Physical attributes without telemetry remain low-confidence baselines.
Determination and personality traits are not reverse-engineered from results.
Competition and club strength are soft calibration priors, never substitutes for player evidence.

teamStrengthPolicy.reason: Avoid split-stage position distortion and excessive early-season volatility.

freezeRule: Change these constants only through a new version and a fresh full sanity review.
